description: Fix dieline geometry engine to generate correct horizontal net layouts (proper cross/T-shape) for RSC/shipping-box and other box styles, and fix canvas rendering to draw blue dashed fold lines and red solid cut lines (actual perimeter, not bounding rect).
steps: 1. Modify src/utils/dielineGeometry.js: Rewrite generateDielineLayout for styleId='shipping-box' to create a horizontal strip layout: a horizontal row of 4 body panels (front L×H, side1 W×H, back L×H, side2 W×H) plus glue flap on the right, with top flaps above the strip and bottom flaps below. Each flap is W/2 tall (major flaps on front/back panels) and L/2 wide (minor flaps on side panels). Vertical fold lines between adjacent horizontal panels, horizontal fold lines between flaps and body strip. Return correct panel positions {x, y, width, height, type} and fold lines {x, y, width, height} (width>0 for horizontal lines, height>0 for vertical lines).

2. Generate the cut lines array as the actual perimeter outline of the net (not just a bounding rect). For a simple rectangular net, this is 4 line segments forming the outer boundary. Store each cut line as {x1, y1, x2, y2, type: 'cut'} or use the existing {x, y, width, height} format if width/height represent the line endpoints.

3. Apply the same horizontal layout strategy to styleId='folding-carton' (similar strip + tuck flaps instead of straight flaps), styleId='mailer-box' (horizontal strip + lid panel attached to one side), and styleId='custom-box' (same as shipping-box).

4. Modify src/components/dieline/DielineCanvas.jsx: Change fold line rendering from grey (#64748b or similar) to blue (#2563eb) dashed lines. Change cut line rendering from drawing a single bounding rectangle to drawing the actual perimeter cut lines returned by the geometry engine. Ensure cut lines are red solid lines.

5. Test with default shipping-box dimensions (300×200×150mm): the net should show a horizontal strip of 4 panels with flaps above and below, fold lines should be blue dashed, cut lines should be red solid perimeter outline. Change dimensions to 400×300×200mm and verify the layout recalculates correctly.
acceptance_criteria: The 2D dieline for shipping-box shows a horizontal strip (front, side1, back, side2) with top and bottom flaps in a proper cross/T-shape net layout, not all panels stacked vertically.
Fold lines render as blue (#2563eb) dashed lines, including vertical lines between horizontal panels and horizontal lines between flaps and body.
Cut lines render as red solid lines forming the actual perimeter of the net, not a bounding rectangle.
Changing dimensions in the properties panel immediately recalculates the geometry and updates the 2D canvas.
Running npm run dev and opening /dieline shows the gallery; clicking any template card and opening the editor shows the corrected 2D net layout.
verification: Verify the 2D canvas shows a horizontal strip layout (not vertical stack)
Verify fold lines are blue dashed
Verify cut lines are red solid perimeter (not grey bounding rect)
Change length from 300 to 400mm in the properties panel
Verify the 2D canvas updates immediately with the new dimensions
